title: Veterans Pension Medical Expense Deduction Base and Threshold Table
content:
# Medical expense deduction figures — Veterans Pension

For Veterans Pension, unreimbursed medical expenses are measured against a threshold set on the basic maximum annual pension rate for the household size, without any housebound or aid-and-attendance increment. That base, and the share of it the expenses must exceed, are fixed per rate category as follows.

| Rate category | Basic rate for the medical deduction (USD per year) | Threshold percentage | Threshold amount (USD per year, derived) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, No Dependents) | 17440 | 5 percent | 872.00 |
| Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, One Dependent) | 22838 | 5 percent | 1141.90 |
| Veterans Pension (Housebound, No Dependents) | 17440 | 5 percent | 872.00 |
| Veterans Pension (Housebound, One Dependent) | 22838 | 5 percent | 1141.90 |
| Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, No Dependents) | 17440 | 5 percent | 872.00 |
| Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, One Dependent) | 22838 | 5 percent | 1141.90 |

The derived column is 5 percent of the base in the same row; a housebound or aid-and-attendance category therefore shares the threshold of the basic category with the same number of dependents.

## Other figures common to every rate category

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Report window for past-period expenses used retroactively | 12 calendar months after the end of the expense year |
| Months over which a recurring monthly medical expense is annualized for a prospective rate | 12 months |
| Paid final expenses of a deceased spouse or child | deductible from countable income |

### Illustration (hypothetical inputs)

A veteran in a no-dependent category with unreimbursed medical expenses of 3000.00 for the year exceeds the 872.00 threshold by 2128.00; a veteran in a one-dependent category with the same 3000.00 exceeds the 1141.90 threshold by 1858.10. Expenses of 800.00 in a no-dependent category do not exceed 872.00, and nothing exceeds the threshold.
